'''Zhou Yulin''' ({{zh|c=周毓麟|p=Zhōu Yùlín}}; 12 February 1923 – 2 March 2021) was a Chinese mathematician and academic of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="man">{{cite news|editor1=Deng Yujiao ({{lang|zh|邓玉娇}})|url=http://www.hunantoday.cn/article/202103/202103031607185904.html |script-title=zh:巨星陨落！两院院士、著名数学家周毓麟逝世|trans-title=Superstar fall! Zhou Yulin, mathematician and academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, is dead |work=hunantoday.cn |date=3 March 2021 |access-date=3 March 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Zhou was born in [[Shanghai]], on 12 February 1923, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] was in [[Zhenhai District|Zhenhai]], [[Zhejiang]].<ref name="gulo"/> In 1941, he was admitted to [[Utopia University]], where he majored in [[mathematics]].<ref name="gulo"/> After graduating in October 1945, he became an assistant at Nanjing Temporary University and one year later was transferred to the Institute of Mathematics, [[Academia Sinica]] as an assistant. In October 1949, he joined the faculty of [[Peking University]]. After studying Russian in Beijing Russian College for several months, he was sent to study at [[Moscow State University]] on government scholarships.<ref name="gulo"/> He returned to China in August 1957 and continued to teach at Peking University. In 1960, he was transferred to the Beijing No.9 Research Institute, the Second Machinery Industry (now [[China Academy of Engineering Physics]]). On 2 March 2021, he died of illness in Beijing, aged 98.<ref name="man"/>

==Contributions==
He contributed to the mathematical simulation and physical processes of China's nuclear weapons.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://new.qq.com/omn/20210303/20210303A0DDJ200.html |script-title=zh:送别！数学家周毓麟院士逝世|trans-title=Farewell! mathematician Zhou Yulin passes away |work=qq.com |date=3 March 2021 |access-date=3 March 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1982 State Natural Science Award (First Class)<ref name="gulo">{{cite news|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2014/12/310404.shtm |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士：周毓麟|trans-title=Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences: Zhou Yilin |work=sciencenet.cn |date=30 December 2014 |access-date=3 March 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 1985 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Special)<ref name="gulo"/>
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="gulo"/>
* 1996 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]
* 1997 Hua Luogeng Mathematics Prize
* 2006 Su Buqing Applied Mathematics Prize (Special)
